What Is Facelift Surgery?

A facelift (rhytidectomy) is a surgical procedure that addresses the visible signs of facial ageing — sagging skin, deep folds, jowls, and loss of muscle tone. Modern facelifting goes beyond simple skin tightening — Dr. Ram Prabhu uses the SMAS (superficial musculo-aponeurotic system) technique to reposition deeper tissues, giving longer-lasting, more natural results.

The aim is not to look "different" but to look like a refreshed, well-rested version of yourself — typically 7-10 years younger. Modern facelift techniques avoid the over-tight, "windswept" appearance of older procedures and focus on restoring natural facial contours.

At our Kondapur clinic, we offer the full spectrum: from the mini facelift (for early jowling in the 40s) to the full SMAS facelift (for established sagging in the 50s-60s) and the deep-plane facelift (for advanced cases). Most patients also benefit from concurrent eyelid surgery, fat grafting, or non-surgical adjuncts to rejuvenate the entire face.

Causes & Indications

Common Causes

  • Genetic predisposition to early facial sagging
  • Cumulative sun exposure (photoageing)
  • Smoking and oxidative stress
  • Significant weight loss leaving loose facial skin
  • Loss of facial volume with ageing
  • Loss of skin elasticity (collagen and elastin breakdown)
  • Gravitational descent of facial fat compartments
  • Underlying bone resorption with age
  • Repetitive facial expressions creating deep folds

Signs You May Need Facelift Surgery

  • Sagging skin along the jawline (jowls)
  • Deep nasolabial folds (smile lines)
  • Marionette lines (corners of mouth)
  • Loss of definition between face and neck
  • Loose neck skin (turkey neck)
  • Hollow cheeks or temples
  • Tired-looking appearance even when rested
  • Photographs no longer reflect how you feel

Types of Facelift Surgery We Offer

Each technique is selected based on your anatomy, goals, and clinical examination by Dr. Ram Prabhu.

Mini Facelift

Shorter incisions, focuses on lower face and jawline. Ideal for early signs of sagging.

Best for: Age 40-50, mild jowling

Duration: 2-3 hrs

Anaesthesia: Local + sedation or General

Stay: Day-care

What Happens on the Day of Facelift Surgery

  1. Step 1 — Arrival & Markings (45 min)

    Pre-op photographs from all angles. Detailed markings while seated upright. Hair clipped or pinned away from incision lines.

  2. Step 2 — Anaesthesia (15 min)

    General anaesthesia for traditional and deep-plane facelifts; local + sedation for mini facelifts.

  3. Step 3 — Incisions (15 min)

    Hidden in the hairline above the temple, in front of the ear, and behind the ear. May extend into the lower scalp for full lift.

  4. Step 4 — SMAS Repositioning (90-150 min)

    Skin is gently lifted to expose the SMAS layer. SMAS is repositioned upward and secured. Excess skin trimmed conservatively.

  5. Step 5 — Liposuction / Fat Grafting (30-45 min)

    If indicated — neck or jowl liposuction; fat grafting to restore volume in cheeks or temples.

  6. Step 6 — Closure (30-45 min)

    Skin closed in layers with fine sutures. Drains placed if needed. Light dressing applied.

  7. Step 7 — Recovery & Discharge (4-6 hrs)

    Observation in recovery room. Most go home the same day; SMAS and deep-plane patients may stay one night.

Recovery Timeline

Day 0

Surgery day

Mild discomfort, swelling, and bruising. Compression dressing in place. Sleep with head elevated.

Day 1-3

Peak swelling

Bruising and swelling peak around Day 3. Cold compresses help. Avoid bending and lifting. Drains removed at 24-48 hours.

Day 5-7

Sutures out

Sutures removed. First glimpse of new shape (still swollen). Can walk and do light activities.

Week 2-3

Social return

Most bruising resolved with concealer-friendly stage. Most patients return to work and social activities. Avoid heavy exercise.

Week 4-6

Light exercise

Light cardio cleared. 70-80% of swelling resolved. Scars pink but flattening.

Month 3

90% final result

Most swelling resolved. Scars fading. Final contour visible.

Month 6-12

Final result

Complete settling. Scars become barely visible. Results last 7-10 years.
